printing.setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

discovery.rationale: Replace redundant bodies/expensive conditional sacrifice with actual nontoken death access, a zero-mana reusable scry outlet and early expendable Zombie. Loss of Horde's activated combat protection is a real unmodeled tradeoff. Protect existing supported death/access/native sources and every standard package gate.

Enchantment death and tribal-entry access remain after creature wipes, plus paid filtering/fixing rock. Trade bodies and combat/counter/discard effects for access redundancy. BBB/3UU setup, life costs and loss of creatures are actual risks; no claim of free reliable draw or recursion.
